Sell my house in Maple Ridge

Fee-simple lots are the default form: Houses sit under the compact urban zones of Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, with RS-1 (Single Detached Residential), s. 605 — minimum lot area 668.0 m², minimum lot width 18.0 m, minimum lot depth 27.0 m, maximum lot coverage 40% — as the standard urban house zone in the bylaw's schedule. The Area Plan's residential designations include Low Density Residential (single detached at an urban standard, with lot sizes at 2,000 m² in the designation text read), Ground-Oriented Residential, Cluster Residential and Townhouse, plus an Albion Village Commercial node.
Rydge is a cross-reference only and is not counted as part of Albion. Sources classify it differently, so a buyer searching under only one name will mix the two areas' stock.
Check a lot's current designation before valuing it as a plain house lot; a designation is not an approval and no development site is listed as inventory here.

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: Municipality: City of Maple Ridge, BC.
The Albion Area Plan's Schedule 1 map is the closest official boundary document.

Main roads and commute: Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) along the south side; 240 Street is the main north–south road; 102 Avenue and 104 Avenue run east–west through the residential area; the Golden Ears Bridge west of the city connects Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows to Langley and Surrey.

Transit: Haney Place Exchange is in the Town Centre to the west (routes include the R3, 701, 733, 741, 743, 744, 745, 746, 748, 749 and 791; the R3 runs Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place). Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) and Maple Meadows Station (20010 Dunn Avenue) serve the west side of the city; West Coast Express trains run weekdays between Waterfront and Mission City.

Schools physically in the area (Ministry-listed names and addresses only): Albion Elementary, 10031 240 Street; c'usqunela Elementary, 24093 104 Avenue; Kanaka Creek Elementary, 11120 234a Street (at the area's west edge); Samuel Robertson Technical Secondary, 10445 245 Street. SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12).

Kanaka Creek Regional Park (Metro Vancouver) runs along the area's west side, with the Canyon Trail to Cliff Falls and the Bell-Irving Hatchery. No library branch sits in Albion — Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road in the Town Centre. Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital with 24/7 emergency care; the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.

The Albion Area Plan is Chapter 10.2 of the OCP, and Council adopted updates to it on October 28, 2025 (walking/cycling connections, local commercial nodes, farmland buffers). Quote the OCP bylaw number only from a current City document for the specific property.

BC strata block — applies in full to any strata lot here (including the four townhome complexes' resales): Form B (SPA s. 59), provided within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (Strata Property Act ss. 123.1/123.2 and Regulation 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is not a valid age bylaw. None of Albion's four complexes carries a 55+ bylaw — Albion has zero known 55+ stock, and Maple Ridge has zero known 55+ strata townhouses. For The Warwick, first establish whether the unit is a developer sale or a resale, because the document route (REDMA/GST vs Form B) differs.

All four townhome complexes stand within a few blocks of one corner. Albion Station, Ridgemont, Spencer Brook Estates and The Warwick all cluster at 104 Avenue / 240 Street, beside the Albion Commercial Corner and c'usqunela Elementary — complex-level comparables here are effectively a single-intersection market, and none of it is lot stock.
Spencer Brook Estates (EPS763, 40 homes, built 2015) was verified by the 55-plus run — while proving it was not 55+ — and never appeared in the condos run's three-complex townhome list.

The farmland buffer is new policy with a date. The Oct 28, 2025 Area Plan update introduced buffers where urban development meets farmland — houses closest to the South Albion ALR edge now sit beside a stated buffer policy, not just a field.

blocks.text: Acreage and rural land in Albion

items.t: Serviced vs unserviced ground: the urban core is serviced growth-area ground in its built form; the South Albion farm edge is rural parcel ground whose servicing is a per-parcel question.

blocks.text: Where the acreages are and what to know

items.t: Suites and SSMUH (urban ground): one secondary suite per lot inside the single detached building, maximum 40% of gross floor area, not within the floodplain area; eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws. On ALR land the ALC suite rule above (inside the principal residence only) controls instead — the two regimes meet at the South Albion line and must not be mixed.

Albion's plan now buffers the farm line instead of erasing it: The October 28, 2025 Area Plan update is the rare growth-area update that adds protection at the edge: buffers where urban development meets farmland, alongside commercial-node growth and walking / cycling links. For a house lot beside South Albion farmland, that buffer policy is part of what the lot will live next to — read the designation, not just the house.

The Rydge seam cuts the other way from most classification fights: Here the developer claims the growth-area name (Albion) and the board claims the hillside name (Thornhill MR) — the reverse of the usual marketing direction.

blocks.text: Where duplexes come up and what to know

items.t: The Albion Area Plan sits in the OCP as Chapter 10.2 per the City's plan pages.

ALR position (South Albion): On ALR land the ALC housing caps govern residences (one residence per parcel generally; principal residence 500 m² or less without an ALC application; one additional residence 90 m² or less on parcels of 40 ha or smaller, 186 m² or less on larger parcels) — farm-residence forms on one parcel under one title, never duplex stock.

items.t: Albion is the east Maple Ridge growth area around 240 Street and Lougheed Highway, listed by the City as "Albion/Kanaka."

The Albion Area Plan, Chapter 10.2 of the Official Community Plan (OCP), is the closest official boundary document, including the North East Albion area and the Albion Flats next to Lougheed Highway and 240 Street.
240 Street runs north-south, 102 Avenue and 104 Avenue run east-west through the housing, and the Fraser River forms the south edge.
Kanaka Creek runs along the west side, with Cottonwood and East Central to the west and Thornhill to the northeast.
Albion's housing is newer detached houses plus ground-oriented and townhouse product, matching the plan's own designation mix.
The industrial lands sit in the Albion Flats by Lougheed Highway, separate from the residential corridors on 102 Avenue and 104 Avenue.
The 2025 update enhances walking and cycling connections and consolidates land-use policies to reflect provincial housing legislation.

blocks.text: Albion: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Albion Community Centre at 24165 104 Avenue is co-located with c'usqunela Elementary at 104 Avenue and 240 Street, and opened June 22, 2022.
The centre replaced the historic Albion Hall on 240 Street, built by volunteers in 1923 and demolished after a 2010 inspection found it at end of life.
Kanaka Creek Regional Park runs 400 hectares along 12 kilometres of Kanaka Creek, with the Canyon Trail to Cliff Falls and the Bell-Irving Hatchery.
The Albion Fairgrounds and Albion Sports Complex at 23778 104 Avenue host Planet Ice and the Golden Ears Winter Club curling rink.
Route 748 loops Haney Place via Lougheed Highway, River Road, 240 Street and 100 Avenue through Thornhill and Albion streets.
Albion Community Centre, 24165 104 Avenue — City facility, completed, grand opening June 22, 2022, co-located with c'usqunela Elementary (status read November 3, 2026).
No West Coast Express station sits in Albion; Port Haney Station at 22300 River Road and Maple Meadows Station serve the city from the west side.
Route 748 is the Albion loop bus to Haney Place, via 240 Street and 100 Avenue.
The Golden Ears Bridge, west of Albion, replaced the Albion Ferry in 2009 and is now the Fraser River crossing to Langley and Surrey.
Check floodplain status and the title covenant for any lot near the Fraser River or Kanaka Creek, using the City's floodplain construction guide and maps.
Check ALR status parcel by parcel for South Albion lots at the farmland edge, where the 2025 plan adds urban-farmland buffers.
Kanaka Creek is a riparian corridor, so lots backing onto the creek need a development-permit and tree check the plan map alone does not settle.

faq.a: There is no lot product to buy — no named bare-land subdivision offering, bare-land strata plan or presale lot offering exists here. What trades is built fee-simple house lots, strata townhomes at the 104/240 corner, and South Albion farm parcels.
faq.q: Can I buy a bare building lot in Albion?

faq.a: A purchase there is a strata-lot purchase with fees, bylaws and a Form B; The Warwick additionally needs a per-unit developer-sale vs resale determination before GST/REDMA treatment is relied on.
faq.q: Are Albion Station, Ridgemont, Spencer Brook and The Warwick land I can buy as lots?

faq.a: Contested: the developer says Albion, the board listings say Thornhill MR. Price a 248 Street listing against the sub-area its listing actually sits in.

Council adopted the update Oct 28, 2025: enhanced walking/cycling connections, support for local commercial nodes, and buffers where urban development meets farmland, consolidating land-use policies for provincial housing legislation. Check a growth-edge lot's current designation before valuing it as a plain house lot.
faq.q: What did the October 2025 Area Plan update change for a lot?

faq.a: Only a parcel-level check settles it. ALR parcels in South Albion are described in words only, with no published split figure. Check the ALC maps and title before pricing subdivision, a second dwelling or farm-class value into the parcel; on ALR ground, subdivision needs ALC approval and residences cannot be stratified.
faq.q: Is this South Albion parcel in the ALR?

faq.a: Council adopted the update on October 28, 2025: it enhances walking and cycling connections, supports growth of local commercial nodes, and introduces buffers where urban development meets farmland. A buffer is a plan policy on the urban side — it does not change the ALC caps, farm class or subdivision rules on the farm parcel itself. Check the lot's current designation before valuing it as a plain house lot.
faq.q: What did the October 2025 Albion Area Plan update change for a lot at the farm edge?

faq.a: Spencer Brook's plan is EPS763; that is a built townhouse strata plan, not a bare-land strata acreage plan.
faq.q: Are Albion Station, Ridgemont, Spencer Brook or The Warwick acreage or bare-land strata?

faq.a: Price and compare it as Thornhill MR board stock, whatever the marketing says.
faq.q: Is Rydge in Albion or Thornhill?

faq.a: Potentially, yes: the south edge sits along the Fraser River and Kanaka Creek, the flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic, no habitable floor space may sit below it on affected lots, and floodplain status is registered by covenant on title.
faq.q: Is flood risk a factor on a South Albion parcel?

faq.a: No. ALR parcels take the ALC housing caps — one parcel, one title, farm-residence forms only as the ALC sources support.
